title: Number-to-text emits 15 significant digits via an exact Q16.64 split on [1, 65536) and x87 low-nibble scaling into Q0.64 elsewhere
statement: Every worksheet consumer of general 15-significant-digit number-to-text conversion (&, CONCAT, CONCATENATE, VALUETOTEXT, ARRAYTOTEXT, FIXED, DOLLAR, TEXT, TEXTJOIN, and general cell formatting) shares one routine (first_precision). For 1.0 <= |x| < 65,536.0 (0 <= exp2 < 16), Branch 1 splits the binary64 significand directly into an integer part w (1..=65535, d digits) and an exact Q0.64 fraction f with no FPU scaling, then adds the truncated half-ulp constant floor(2^63 / 10^(15 - d)); because floor(2^63 / 10^k) < 2^63 / 10^k, exact binary ties below 65,536 never round up, and [1, 10) rounds up only past +0.07204 ulp64(v). For |x| < 1.0 or |x| >= 65,536.0, Branch 2 computes p = ceil((exp2 + 1) / 3.3219) (0 for [0.5, 1)), multiplies x by 10^-p using the low-nibble-first x87 PC64 table chain (10^+-1..15, 10^+-16..240, 10^+-256) with one 10^-1 step if scaled v >= 1.0, shifts the 64-bit significand mv into Q0.64 by a truncating right shift, and adds floor(2^63 / 10^k) (k in 15..=17). That explains why [0.5, 1) and below-2^k values require +0.372036854775808 ulp64(v) to round up, while above-2^k values exhibit a period-8 oscillation +3.37203685 + 1.25 * (mv & 7) ulp64(10v). See https://github.com/DnaCalc/DnaCalc/blob/344d70dcea3ea77cbbeee1595f96694630a9610a/docs/articles/last-bit-number-text.md.
basis: Measured on 21,377 probe and W111 rows (21,377 of 21,377 matched), 29 formerly failing oracle-corpus cells (29 of 29 matched across dc_q9rb, catalogue, and fn7_format_context), and three prospective frozen proofs in nx8 on Excel 16.0.20527.20196: 600 of 600 on frozen_cb9_predictions.jsonl, 32 of 32 on the 4-binade discriminator (exp2 in {-971, -486, +484, +969}, settling ceil(frexp_k / 3.3219) 32/32 vs ceil(frexp_k * log10(2)) 0/32), and 20 of 20 on the 10^-1 sliver step. Post-study witness banks: CONCAT 3,578 of 3,578, CONCATENATE 3,133 of 3,133, FIXED 3,783 of 3,783, VALUETOTEXT 2,571 of 2,571.
inferred: Whether Excel implements Branch 1 via integer bit-shifts or x87 fistp+fsub is unobservable from outputs and inferred; both give identical (w, f) for every binary64 in [1.0, 65536.0).
